purpose: Determine the archived ZIP container structure and filename date coverage before opening any member payload or economic field.
allowed: HEAD or zero-byte-equivalent metadata request to the exact replay target
bounded HTTP byte-range reads required to locate ZIP EOCD and central directory
parse ZIP EOCD and central-directory metadata only
record container content length, ETag/Last-Modified if exposed, range support, member names, CRC32, compressed size, uncompressed size, compression method and ZIP metadata timestamps
derive filename dates from the already-observed YYMMDD_shorting.tsv naming rule
compute first/last filename date, month set, consecutive month coverage and missing months
compare central-directory metadata for overlapping member names against the current community ZIP metadata in a later separately-frozen authentication stage
forbidden: read or decompress any ZIP member payload
open FEERATE, AVAILABLE or any economic field
select members or dates based on economic values
treat filename coverage as economic-data admission
use credentials, API keys, AWS login, Gmail login or account-specific authentication
transport_fail_closed: if the replay does not honor byte ranges, do not silently download the full archive in this stage
if EOCD or central-directory bounds are inconsistent, stop
if ZIP64 is required, parse ZIP64 metadata only if it can be obtained by bounded ranges; otherwise stop
if any requested range returns a full-body 200 response, close without reading the body and mark RANGE_UNSUPPORTED
